title: CHESS: Chebyshev pseudo-spectral transport for Feynman integral differential equations
description: p1^2=p2^2=0, s=(p1+p2)^2; D2,D4 massive (m), others massless; D7=l1^2 ISP
mapping_notes: Same order as paper eq.(2) with kappa=0. m^2=1, x=s/m^2, y=-m^2/s.
integrals_meaning: top-sector scalar I_{1111110} (elliptic, no printed scalar value)
reference_combination: M4 = eps^4 x I_paper_{1111100}, M6 = eps^4 x I_paper_{1110110} (2305.13951 eq. for M^(b)_4, M^(b)_6), x=s/m^2; I_paper = e^{2 eps gammaE} prod d^D l/(i pi^{D/2}) with D=q^2-m^2 => I_paper = (-1)^5 I_DiffExp. So M4 = -eps^4 x e^{2 eps gammaE} I_DiffExp = 20 eps^4 e^{2eps gammaE} I_DiffExp: the eps^4 coefficient of M equals 20 * (finite eps^0 value of I_DiffExp). Rows of CHESS file assumed to be M1..M18 in paper order (rows 4,6,8 are zero below eps^4, consistent with finite eps^4-normalized integrals and the positive sign predicted).
normalization: Paper: e^{2 eps gammaE} (m^2)^{nu-D} int d^D l1/(i pi^{D/2}) d^D l2/(i pi^{D/2}) D7^{-nu7}/prod D_i^{nu_i}, D_i Minkowski q^2-m^2.
